```sql
WITH ecom_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN o.items_subtotal * fx.aud_nzd_rate
            ELSE o.items_subtotal
        END AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
),
pos_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        t.transaction_id AS order_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.currency = 'AUD' THEN SUM(t.line_total) * fx.aud_nzd_rate
            ELSE SUM(t.line_total)
        END AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON t.txn_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND t.txn_date <= '2025-12-31'
      AND t.txn_type = 'SALE'
      AND t.is_valid = TRUE
    GROUP BY t.transaction_id, s.currency, fx.aud_nzd_rate
),
erp_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        l.sales_order_id AS order_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN SUM(l.net_value) * fx.aud_nzd_rate
            ELSE SUM(l.net_value)
        END AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON l.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date >= '2025-12-01' 
      AND l.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.sales_order_id, l.currency, fx.aud_nzd_rate
),
all_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_revenue FROM ecom_orders
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, order_revenue FROM pos_orders
    UNION ALL
    SELECT order_id, order_revenue FROM erp_orders
)
SELECT SUM(order_revenue) / COUNT(order_id) AS answer
FROM all_orders;
```
